feeds.title: Wandtattoo.Design
feeds.description: I designed the chakra t-shirts and hoodies or chakras, yantra, or OM signs in different variations as wall tattoos in different colors. My design is influenced by Asian influences and these influences have become my style. I love the variety of colors from India or Thailand, especially the saris and the temples. It's good to bring a little more happy colors to the sometimes gray Germany and so I contribute to this with my product design.

feeds.title: Shiv Shiv Yoga News
feeds.description: Yoga blog from a men's perspective. Growing up in Karlsruhe, I was drawn to Berlin at some point, where my practice was strongly influenced by Jivamukti Yoga. My classes have strong Jivamukti influences, with a demanding athleticism and enough space for meditation, breathing and music. When I'm not teaching or practicing yoga, I write for my Yogadude blog, make music, or do something with the family.
